thesis: The guest argues that very few people currently use decentralized applications because they are inferior to centralized counterparts in performance, scalability, and usability. He illustrates this gap by noting that Bitcoin processes roughly seven to ten transactions per second compared to Visa's 60,000 transactions per second on Christmas, and he emphasizes that retaining a decentralized model requires managing private keys, which reintroduces centralization risks if users rely on online wallets or exchanges.
